examples.en: This factory manufactures car parts.
The company makes and sells food itself.
I learned how to manufacture soap.
That's a company that makes cosmetics.
The product made last year is past its expiration date.
To manufacture safely, you need facilities.

explain: '만들다'는 아무 때나 쓰는 말이고, '제조하다'는 공장에서 재료로 물건을 만드는 산업적인 말이에요. 집에서 요리하거나 만들기를 할 때는 쓰지 않아요. '제조업', '제조일자'처럼 합쳐서도 많이 나와요.

phrases.en: My uncle works at a manufacturing company.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건을 만드는 산업을 가리키는 합친 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A compound word for the industry that makes goods.

phrases.en: This snack is made in Korea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건이 주어일 때 쓰는 피동형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The passive form, used when the product is the subject.

phrases.en: I checked the milk's manufacturing date.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건을 만든 날짜를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the date a product was made.

explain_en: Active: making products in a factory; formal and industrial. 만들다 is the all-purpose word; 제조하다 is the industrial one for making goods from materials in a factory. You would not use it for home cooking or crafts. It often appears in compounds like 제조업 (manufacturing industry) and 제조일자 (date of manufacture).

gh: make goods or crops in quantity

p.n: 생산하다 just says the company makes the medicine; 제조하다 stresses the manufacturing process.

t90.ax: I learned how to manufacture soap.

examples.en: I majored in statistics and became a data analyst.
The statistics class is hard because there are so many numbers.

examples.ko: 통계학 교수님이 시험 범위를 알려 주셨어요.
examples.en: The statistics professor told us what the exam covers.

examples.ko: 통계학을 배우면 뉴스 속 숫자를 잘 읽을 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you learn statistics, you can read the numbers in the news well.

examples.ko: 동생은 대학에서 통계학과 경제학을 같이 공부해요.
examples.en: My younger sibling studies statistics and economics together at university.
Statistics is widely used in artificial intelligence these days.

explain: '통계'는 모은 숫자나 그 결과이고, '통계학'은 그것을 다루는 학문 이름이에요. '경제학, 심리학'처럼 '-학'이 붙은 말은 공부하는 분야를 가리켜요. 뉴스에서는 '통계에 따르면'처럼 통계만 쓰는 때가 훨씬 많아요.

phrases.en: My younger sibling is in the statistics department at university.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학의 학과 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The name of a university department.

phrases.en: He is a famous statistician.
phrases.nuance_ko: 통계학을 연구하는 사람이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A person who studies statistics.

phrases.en: I study statistics to read data well.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학문을 배운다는 뜻으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means studying the academic field.

explain_en: 통계 is the collected numbers or their results, and 통계학 is the name of the field that studies them. Words ending in '-학', like 경제학 and 심리학, name a field of study. In the news you hear 통계 alone far more, as in '통계에 따르면'.

t90.ax: I majored in statistics and became a data analyst.

examples.en: My grandfather chose the house site by looking at feng shui.

examples.ko: 풍수지리에 따르면 이 집은 터가 좋대요.
examples.en: According to feng shui, this house sits on a good site.

examples.ko: 저는 풍수지리에 관심이 많아서 책을 읽고 있어요.
examples.en: I'm very interested in feng shui, so I'm reading a book on it.

examples.ko: 풍수지리 때문에 문을 어느 쪽으로 낼지 고민했어요.
examples.en: I agonized over which side to put the door on because of feng shui.
We picked the office location with feng shui in mind.

examples.ko: 풍수지리를 믿는 사람이 주변에 아직 있어요.
examples.en: There are still people around me who believe in feng shui.

explain: 줄여서 '풍수'라고도 해요. 집터나 묏자리를 고를 때, 요즘은 가구 배치를 말할 때 '풍수 인테리어'처럼도 써요. 과학이라기보다 전통적인 믿음으로 이야기하는 경우가 많아요.

phrases.en: My grandmother really believes in feng-shui.
phrases.nuance_ko: '풍수지리'를 줄인 말로, 일상 대화에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shortened form of 풍수지리, more common in everyday talk.

phrases.en: I decorated the entrance following feng-shui principles.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가구나 물건 배치를 말할 때 쓰는 요즘 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A modern expression used for arranging furniture and objects.

phrases.en: They say this neighborhood has good feng-shui.
phrases.nuance_ko: 터나 집이 좋다고 평가할 때 같이 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say a site or house is favorable.

explain_en: It is often shortened to '풍수'. It comes up when choosing a house site or grave site, and now also in things like '풍수 인테리어' (feng shui interior). People usually talk about it as a traditional belief rather than science.

examples.ko: 선수들은 대회 전에 한 달 동안 합숙을 해요.
examples.en: The athletes live together for a month before the competition.

examples.ko: 합숙 훈련이 힘들었지만 친구가 많이 생겼어요.
examples.en: The group training camp was hard, but I made many friends.
Our club has a group stay every vacation.

examples.ko: 합숙 비용은 한 사람당 오만 원이에요.
examples.en: The cost of the group stay is fifty thousand won per person.

examples.ko: 합숙 중에는 휴대폰을 쓸 수 없어요.
examples.en: You can't use your phone during the group stay.
Most trainees live together in a dormitory.

explain: '합숙 훈련', '합숙소', '합숙 생활'로 자주 써요. 운동팀이나 연습생처럼 정해진 목표가 있는 그룹에 쓰고, 친구들끼리 놀러 가서 자는 건 합숙이라고 하지 않아요. 동아리의 모임 여행은 'MT'라고 해요.

phrases.en: The players stay together in the training camp dorm.
phrases.nuance_ko: 합숙하는 사람들이 함께 자는 건물을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The building where people in group lodging sleep together.

phrases.en: It was my first time living in a group camp, so it was a bit hard.
phrases.nuance_ko: 함께 지내는 생활 전체를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the whole life of staying together.

phrases.en: We start the group camp from tomorrow.
phrases.nuance_ko: 합숙을 시작할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the group stay begins.
phrases.en_equiv: to go into a training camp

explain_en: Common combinations are '합숙 훈련', '합숙소', and '합숙 생활'. It is for groups with a shared goal, like sports teams or trainees; friends sleeping over on a trip would not call it '합숙'. A club's group trip is called 'MT'.

examples.ko: 수족관에서 커다란 가오리가 천천히 헤엄치고 있었어요.
examples.en: A huge ray was swimming slowly in the aquarium.
A ray has a flat body, so it looks like a diamond shape.

examples.ko: 아이는 가오리를 직접 만져 보고 신기해했어요.
examples.en: The child touched a ray for himself and was amazed.
On the weekend, I flew a ray-shaped kite in the park with my child.

examples.ko: 바다 속에서 가오리 한 마리가 날개를 펄럭이듯 지나갔어요.
examples.en: Under the sea, a ray passed by as if flapping its wings.

examples.ko: 가오리와 상어는 둘 다 뼈가 물렁뼈인 물고기예요.
examples.en: Rays and sharks are both fish whose skeletons are made of cartilage.

explain: 몸이 납작하고 넓은 지느러미가 있는 물고기로, 홍어와 비슷하게 생겼지만 다른 물고기예요. '가오리연'은 이 물고기 모양을 닮은 연을 말해요. 수족관이나 바다 이야기에서 만나기 쉬운 말이에요.

phrases.en: We flew a stingray kite at the beach.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가오리 모양을 닮은 연이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A kite shaped like a stingray.

phrases.en: I bought one ray at the market.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물고기는 '마리'로 세므로 수를 말할 때 이렇게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fish are counted with 마리, so this is how to give a number.

phrases.en: I saw a school of rays under the sea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 마리가 함께 있을 때 '떼'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add 떼 for a group of them together.

explain_en: It is a flat fish with broad fins and looks similar to a skate (홍어), but it is a different fish. '가오리연' is a kite shaped like this fish. It is a word you are likely to meet when talking about aquariums or the sea.

t90.ax: A huge ray was swimming slowly in the aquarium.

examples.ko: 마을 입구에 오래된 거목이 서 있어요.
examples.en: An old giant tree stands at the entrance of the village.
He is a giant of the Korean literary world.

examples.ko: 태풍 때문에 길가의 거목 한 그루가 쓰러졌어요.
examples.en: Because of the typhoon, a huge roadside tree fell.
I rested for a moment in the shade of the big tree.
They say this giant tree has lived for hundreds of years.
That politician is called a giant of the party.

explain: '큰 나무'는 일상 말이고, 거목은 글이나 뉴스에서 더 자주 보여요. 비유로는 한 분야를 오래 이끌어 존경받는 원로에게 '문학계의 거목', '정계의 거목'이라고 해요. '거장'이 뛰어난 솜씨에 초점이 있다면, 거목은 영향력과 연륜이 큰 사람에 가까워요.

phrases.en: He is called a giant of the literary world.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한 분야를 이끈 존경받는 원로를 비유할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing for a respected elder who has led a field.

phrases.en: The small seed grew into a giant tree.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나무나 사람이 크게 자랐다는 뜻으로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a tree or a person who has grown big.

phrases.en: I rested for a while under a big tree.
phrases.nuance_ko: '거목'의 일상적인 말이라 대화에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The everyday word for 거목, more common in conversation.

explain_en: Literally a huge tree; figuratively a giant in a field. '큰 나무' is the everyday phrase, while 거목 appears more in writing and news. Figuratively, a respected elder who led a field for many years is called a '문학계의 거목' or '정계의 거목'. Where '거장' focuses on outstanding skill, 거목 leans toward great influence and long standing.

examples.en: There are many short shrubs in the garden.

examples.ko: 관목은 줄기가 여러 개로 갈라져 자라요.
examples.en: Shrubs grow with their stems splitting into several branches.
We planted shrubs along the road to make a hedge.
A shrub forest continues along the middle of the mountain.

examples.ko: 이 관목에는 봄에 작은 꽃이 피어요.
examples.en: Small flowers bloom on this shrub in spring.

examples.ko: 겨울에도 관목의 잎이 푸르게 남아 있어요.
examples.en: The shrub's leaves stay green even in winter.

explain: '관목'은 키가 작고 줄기가 여러 갈래로 자라는 나무예요. 반대말은 키가 큰 '교목'이에요. 일상에서는 그냥 '나무'나 '덤불'이라고 하고, '관목'은 식물 설명이나 과학 글에서 나와요.

phrases.example: 산길 옆에 관목 숲이 넓게 펼쳐져 있어요.
phrases.en: A wide shrub thicket stretches out beside the mountain path.
phrases.nuance_ko: 키 작은 나무가 모여 있는 곳을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a place where low trees grow together.

phrases.en: We planted shrubs along the fence.
phrases.nuance_ko: 정원이나 길가에 나무를 심는 상황에서 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A collocation for planting trees in a garden or along a road.

phrases.example: 봄이 되자 관목에 노란 꽃이 피었어요.
phrases.en: When spring came, yellow flowers bloomed on the shrubs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조사 '에'를 붙여 식물의 변화를 설명하는 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses the particle 에 to describe a change in a plant.

explain_en: '관목' is a short plant whose stems grow in several branches. Its opposite is the tall tree '교목'. In daily speech people just say '나무' or '덤불', while '관목' appears in plant descriptions and science writing.

en: to be vast; to be extensive; to be immense

examples.en: Siberia is truly vast.
I can see a field stretching vastly before my eyes.
They say space is far vaster than we imagine.

examples.ko: 그 나라는 땅이 광대해서 지역마다 날씨가 달라요.
examples.en: That country's land is vast, so the weather differs by region.
I've never seen such a vast desert.

examples.ko: 그 공원은 광대할 뿐 아니라 경치도 아름다워요.
examples.en: That park is not only vast but also beautiful.

explain: 땅, 바다, 우주, 지식처럼 범위가 아주 넓을 때 써요. '넓다'보다 웅장한 느낌이고 말보다 글에서 더 자주 나와요. 방이나 길에는 쓰지 않고 '광대한 ~' 모양으로 많이 써요.

phrases.en: They farm on a vast stretch of land.
phrases.nuance_ko: '광대한 ~' 모양으로 명사를 꾸며 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in the form '광대한 ~' to modify a noun.

phrases.en: The universe is so vast that it has no end.
phrases.nuance_ko: 해요체로 말할 때 쓰고, 우주나 바다처럼 아주 큰 범위에 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite spoken form; fits very large scopes like the universe or the sea.

phrases.en: The grassland stretches out vast before my eyes.
phrases.nuance_ko: '광대하게'로 동사를 꾸며 넓은 풍경을 그릴 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The adverb form '광대하게' describes a wide landscape spreading out.

explain_en: Sino-Korean, formal or written, for great scale of land or knowledge. Use it for land, sea, space, or knowledge with a very wide range. It feels grander than 넓다 and shows up more in writing than speech. It is not used for rooms or roads, and often appears as '광대한 ~'.

examples.ko: 이 생수에는 광물질이 많이 들어 있어요.
examples.en: This bottled water contains a lot of minerals.
Minerals are important for bone health.
Plants get minerals from the soil.

examples.ko: 이 화장품에는 광물질 성분이 들어 있어요.
examples.en: This cosmetic contains mineral ingredients.

examples.ko: 비타민뿐만 아니라 광물질도 꼭 챙겨 드세요.
examples.en: Make sure to take minerals as well as vitamins.
It's a paint made with color taken from minerals.

explain: 땅이나 돌에서 나오는 무기물을 말해요. 영양 이야기에서는 '미네랄'이라고 더 많이 해요. '광물질'은 설명하는 글이나 수업에서 자주 보여요.

phrases.en: This hot spring water is rich in minerals.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물이나 흙에 광물질이 많을 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A collocation for water or soil that contains a lot of mineral matter.

phrases.en: I drink water with lots of minerals.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뜻은 비슷하지만 영양과 건강 이야기에서는 '미네랄'이 더 흔해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar meaning, but 'mineral' is more common when talking about nutrition and health.

phrases.example: 제품 뒷면에서 광물질 성분을 확인해 보세요.
phrases.en: Check the mineral content on the back of the product.
phrases.nuance_ko: 제품 설명에서 무엇으로 만들어졌는지 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used in product descriptions to say what something is made of.

explain_en: Mineral substances, often beneficial (water, nutrition); neutral/scientific. It refers to inorganic substances that come from the earth or rocks. In talk about nutrition, people more often say '미네랄'. '광물질' appears more in explanatory texts and classes.

en: raised path between rice paddies; paddy embankment

examples.ko: 모내기가 끝나고 나서 동칠이는 그 논둑에 콩을 심었어요.
examples.en: After the rice transplanting was over, Dongchil planted beans on that paddy ridge.

examples.ko: 비가 오면 논둑이 미끄러워서 조심해야 해요.
examples.en: When it rains, the paddy ridges are slippery, so you have to be careful.
The children played, running along the paddy ridge.
We sat on the paddy ridge and ate a snack.

examples.ko: 논둑길을 걷다 보니 개구리 소리가 크게 들렸어요.
examples.en: As I walked along the path between the paddies, I heard frogs croaking loudly.
The cow climbs up the paddy ridge and grazes on the grass.

explain: 논과 논 사이, 또는 논 가장자리에 흙을 쌓아 만든 둑이에요. '논두렁'이라고도 해요. 시골 풍경이나 옛이야기에서 '논둑길'처럼 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: I walked slowly along the path on the rice-field ridge.
phrases.nuance_ko: 논둑 위에 난 좁은 길을 말해요. 시골 풍경 이야기에 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: A narrow path on a field ridge, often used in countryside scenes.

phrases.en: The children play on the ridges between the fields.
phrases.nuance_ko: '논둑'과 같은 뜻의 비슷한 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A synonym with the same meaning as '논둑'.

phrases.en: While working, I sat on the ridge and rested.
phrases.nuance_ko: 논 가장자리에 앉아 쉬는 모습을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes sitting to rest at the edge of a rice field.
phrases.en_equiv: to sit on the field ridge

explain_en: Narrow raised ridge between rice paddies, used as a footpath. It is the earthen bank built between rice paddies or along their edges. It is also called '논두렁'. It often appears in country scenery and old stories, as in '논둑길' (the path along the ridge).

examples.ko: 우리는 산 능선을 따라 천천히 걸었어요.
examples.en: We walked slowly along the mountain ridge.

examples.ko: 능선 위에서 보는 해돋이가 정말 멋있어요.
examples.en: The sunrise seen from the ridge is really beautiful.
When the fog cleared, a distant ridge came into view.

examples.ko: 바람이 센 능선에서는 모자를 꼭 잡아야 해요.
examples.en: On a windy ridge, you have to hold your hat tight.

examples.ko: 저 능선만 넘으면 마을이 나올 거예요.
examples.en: Once we cross that ridge, we'll reach the village.

examples.ko: 이 능선은 길이 좁아서 조심해야 해요.
examples.en: The path on this ridge is narrow, so be careful.

explain: 산에서 '산꼭대기'는 제일 높은 한 점이고, '능선'은 그 꼭대기들을 이어 주는 길쭉한 선이에요. 등산 이야기에서 '능선을 타다', '능선을 따라 걷다'처럼 자주 써요.

phrases.en: On the weekend I hiked along the ridge with my friends.
phrases.nuance_ko: 등산에서 능선 길을 따라 걷는 것을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: In hiking, it means walking along a ridge trail.

phrases.en: It is very windy on the ridge trail.
phrases.nuance_ko: 능선 위로 난 길을 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the path along the top of a ridge.

phrases.en: When I got up on the ridge, I could see the whole village.
phrases.nuance_ko: 꼭대기가 아니라 능선 위로 올라갈 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for climbing up onto the ridge rather than the summit.
phrases.en_equiv: to climb up onto the ridge

explain_en: '산꼭대기' is the single highest point, while 능선 is the long line that connects the peaks. In hiking talk you often hear '능선을 타다' or '능선을 따라 걷다'.

examples.ko: 이 지역은 대부분 늪지대라서 집을 짓기 어려워요.
examples.en: Most of this area is swampland, so it's hard to build houses.

examples.ko: 늪지대에는 희귀한 새와 식물이 많이 살아요.
examples.en: Many rare birds and plants live in the wetlands.

examples.ko: 늪지대를 걸을 때는 발이 빠질 수 있으니 조심하세요.
examples.en: Be careful when walking through a swamp because your feet can sink.

examples.ko: 우리는 늪지대 생태 체험을 하러 갔어요.
examples.en: We went on an ecological field trip to a swamp.
I got bitten by a lot of mosquitoes in the damp swamp.

examples.ko: 도시가 커지면서 늪지대가 점점 줄고 있어요.
examples.en: As the city grows, the swampland is gradually shrinking.

explain: '늪'이 물이 고여 질척한 땅 하나라면, '늪지대'는 그런 곳이 넓게 이어진 지역이에요. 비슷한 '습지'는 물기가 많은 땅을 더 넓게 가리켜요. '-지대'는 '산악 지대'처럼 다른 말 뒤에 붙는 말이에요.

phrases.en: This is a wetland where many water birds live.
phrases.nuance_ko: '늪지대'보다 물기가 많은 땅을 더 넓게 가리키는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A broader word than 늪지대 for any land with a lot of moisture.

phrases.en: We drove through a wide swampland.
phrases.nuance_ko: 크기를 말할 때 '넓은'을 붙여서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: '넓은' is often added to describe the size.

phrases.en: Alligators live in warm swamps.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동물이나 식물이 사는 곳을 말할 때 조사 '에'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with the particle 에 to say where animals or plants live.

explain_en: While '늪' is a single muddy, water-logged place, '늪지대' is a wide area where such places continue. The similar '습지' refers to wet land more broadly. '-지대' is a suffix that attaches to other words, as in '산악 지대'.

examples.en: I found salamander eggs by the stream.
They say salamanders are often seen in clear valleys.
The child caught a salamander and showed it to me.
The salamander slowly crept into a crack in the rock.
I went to the valley to take photos of salamanders.
Salamanders live in the pond in the forest.

explain: 도마뱀과 헷갈리기 쉬운데, 도롱뇽은 물가에 사는 양서류이고 도마뱀은 파충류예요. 표준어는 '도롱뇽'이고, 맑은 계곡이나 연못 이야기에서 자주 나와요.

phrases.example: 계곡 바위 밑에서 도롱뇽 알을 봤어요.
phrases.en: I saw salamander eggs under a rock in the valley.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도롱뇽은 물속에 알을 낳아서 '알'과 함께 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Salamanders lay eggs in water, so this pairing is common.

phrases.en: Salamanders live in this valley.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도롱뇽이 사는 곳을 소개할 때 '살다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Pairs with 살다 to say where salamanders live.

phrases.en: I saw a salamander at the forest pond yesterday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조사 '을'을 붙여서 직접 도롱뇽을 만난 경험을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: With the particle 을, it tells of actually seeing one.

explain_en: People often confuse it with a lizard (도마뱀), but a 도롱뇽 is an amphibian living near water, while a 도마뱀 is a reptile. The standard spelling is '도롱뇽', and it often comes up in talk about clear valleys and ponds.

examples.en: Grasshoppers hop around the rice fields in autumn.
The children are catching grasshoppers.
Grasshoppers live on grass.

examples.ko: 메뚜기 한 마리가 내 어깨에 앉았어요.
examples.en: A grasshopper landed on my shoulder.
I heard people used to eat stir-fried grasshoppers.
Try jumping high like a grasshopper.

explain: 메뚜기는 곤충이지만 예전에는 가을에 볶아서 반찬으로 먹기도 했어요. 비슷하게 풀밭에서 보이는 곤충으로 방아깨비가 있고, 가을밤에 우는 곤충은 귀뚜라미예요.

phrases.en: A grasshopper jumps high in the grass.
phrases.nuance_ko: 메뚜기의 가장 특징적인 움직임을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes the grasshopper's most characteristic movement.

phrases.en: As a child, I caught grasshoppers in the rice field.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곤충을 잡는 놀이를 이야기할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when talking about catching insects as play.

phrases.example: 풀잎 위에 메뚜기 한 마리가 앉아 있어요.
phrases.en: A grasshopper is sitting on a blade of grass.
phrases.nuance_ko: 곤충은 '마리'로 세요.
phrases.nuance_en: Insects are counted with 마리.

explain_en: 메뚜기 is an insect, but people used to stir-fry it as a side dish in autumn. Another insect seen in grass is the 방아깨비, while the one that sings on autumn nights is the 귀뚜라미.

examples.en: In spring, I planted an apple tree sapling in the yard.

examples.ko: 시장에서 묘목 한 그루에 얼마인지 물어봤어요.
examples.en: I asked at the market how much one sapling cost.

examples.ko: 묘목이 잘 자라도록 물을 자주 줘요.
examples.en: I water the sapling often so that it grows well.

examples.ko: 묘목은 키가 작아서 바람에 쉽게 꺾여요.
examples.en: Saplings are short, so they snap easily in the wind.

examples.ko: 식목일에 학교에서 묘목 나누어 주기 행사를 했어요.
examples.en: On Arbor Day, my school held an event giving out saplings.
Please put a fence around the young sapling.

explain: 옮겨 심으려고 키운 어린 나무를 말해요. 이미 크게 자란 것은 그냥 '나무'라고 하고, 묘목을 셀 때는 '그루'를 써서 '묘목 세 그루'라고 해요. 보통 묘목은 가게나 시장에서 사요.

phrases.en: I planted saplings with my family on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어린 나무를 땅에 옮겨 심을 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common collocation for planting young trees.

phrases.en: I bought three persimmon tree saplings.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나무를 세는 단위 '그루'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with the counter 그루, which is for trees.

phrases.en: In spring I buy saplings at the market.
phrases.nuance_ko: 묘목은 보통 가게나 시장에서 산다는 것을 보여 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Shows that saplings are usually bought at shops or markets.

explain_en: It means a young tree grown to be transplanted. A fully grown one is simply a '나무', and saplings are counted with '그루', as in '묘목 세 그루'. People usually buy saplings at nurseries or markets.
